leadText: (Japanese: Final Episode) is the third regular and final chapter of the Pocket Monster: Liko's treasure manga. It was first published in the August 2023 issue of Ciao, released on July 3, 2023. It is based on the Pokémon Horizons: The Series episode For Sure! 'Cause Sprigatito's with Me!. It is 31 pages long.
